import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import numpy as np

# --- Data (Qwen-2.5-7B, seed42, N=1190) ---
# Ordered by ECE descending: no_trace > full_trace > vota > exception_only
conditions = ["no_trace", "full_trace", "vota", "exception_only"]
labels = ["No Trace", "Full Trace", "VoTA", "Exception Only"]
ece = [0.1715, 0.0958, 0.0054, 0.0027]

# Okabe-Ito palette
colors = {
    "no_trace": "#999999",
    "full_trace": "#56B4E9",
    "vota": "#E69F00",
    "exception_only": "#009E73",
}
bar_colors = [colors[c] for c in conditions]

# --- Figure setup ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.6))

x = np.arange(len(conditions))
bar_width = 0.55
bars = ax.bar(x, ece, width=bar_width, color=bar_colors, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)

# Log scale
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set_ylim(1e-3, 0.35)
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax.yaxis.get_major_formatter().set_scientific(False)
ax.set_yticks([0.001, 0.01, 0.1])
ax.set_yticklabels(["0.001", "0.01", "0.1"])

# Annotate each bar with ECE value
for bar, val in zip(bars, ece):
    ax.text(
        bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
        val * 1.25,
        f"{val:.4f}",
        ha="center", va="bottom",
        fontsize=7, fontfamily="DejaVu Sans",
    )

# Axes
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("Expected Calibration Error (ECE)", fontsize=9)

# Spines
ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
ax.tick_params(axis="both", which="both", labelsize=8)

plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)

# --- Save ---
out_dir = "/root/trace-verdict-study/figures/paper"
fig.savefig(f"{out_dir}/fig2_calibration.pdf", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
fig.savefig(f"{out_dir}/fig2_calibration.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close(fig)
print("Done: fig2_calibration.pdf + .png saved")
